components: The trusted network boundary determines the effective client IP.
Requests sharing the address consume one abuse-prevention allowance.
Normal traffic proceeds until the rate or burst limit is reached.
Excess traffic is challenged, delayed, or rejected.
Trusted proxies and crowded NAT addresses receive adjusted policy.
